summary: appearance.json and costumes.json disagree on two default-look details (Magpie muffler; Fish-Footman lower legs). Sheets follow costumes.json default outfit as the order requires.

findings.appearance: bible/characters/CHAR-magpie/appearance.json marks[0] + prompt_base_en + default_outfit_tone: a dark grey knitted wool muffler wound round the throat at his exit (ch003-p47).
findings.costumes: bible/costumes.json COS-027 visual: 'played as a fluffed-up throat, not a muffler'; prohibited_in_prompt: 'clothing or scarf on the magpie'.
findings.sheet_handling: sheet.png drawn bare with fluffed throat feathers (COS-027). The muffler is not drawn.
findings.decision_needed: Is the exit muffler kept as a scene prop (then costumes.json should allow it as a variant/prop) or dropped (then appearance marks/prompt_base_en should drop it)?

ruling.decision: DROP the muffler from the default look; keep the sourced action, and record the rejected muffler rather than deleting it.
ruling.reasoning: The wrapping-up and the throat are source-written (ch003-p47); the knitted muffler itself was inferred:true. Under SUP-002 as amended by BIB-0027 (user ruling: talking animals are photoreal CGI and wear only the garments the text NAMES) an inferred garment cannot stay, and the H2-locked sheet draws a bare fluffed throat. The canon detail is therefore not dropped: the 'wrapping himself up very carefully' beat survives in full as exit business (fluffed throat ruff, head drawn down, shoulders hunched), recorded on both cards.
writes: bible/characters/CHAR-magpie/appearance.json: marks[0] retyped signature_item -> exit_business (no garment); rendering.limits 'No clothing apart from the muffler' -> no clothing at all; default_outfit_tone.summary; prompt_base_en muffler clause replaced by the fluffed-throat business
bible/costumes.json COS-027: new canon_action_kept and rejected_design (COS-027-rejected-muffler, full source anchor + restore conditions); prohibited_in_prompt points at the rejected id

findings.appearance: default_outfit_tone: '... crimson knee breeches, white stockings, buckled pumps (per H2 Option A)'.
findings.costumes: COS-035 visual_en: 'the fins, hands and lower legs left in natural wet-sheened scaled skin' (no stockings, no shoes).
findings.sheet_handling: sheet.png follows COS-035 visual_en verbatim: bare scaled lower legs and webbed feet, no stockings or pumps. Anatomy itself is pending_H2 (H2-footmen-anatomy).
findings.decision_needed: Align the two cards after the H2 footmen-anatomy ruling.

ruling.decision: Align appearance.json to the sheet and COS-035: no white stockings, no buckled pumps. Crimson knee breeches stay; the lower legs and feet are bare wet-sheened scaled skin.
ruling.reasoning: H2 approved footmen anatomy Option A (upright livery figure with a real fish head), so the Option A/Option B conditional is gone. Where the two layers disagreed the H2-locked sheet followed COS-035, so appearance.json moves.
